label: the action control drops below the signed 44pt touch floor (R-rn-approvals-screen)
test: cd mobile-rn && npx jest src/screens/Approvals.test.tsx -t "KIN-MOBILE-001 R5: every action is a labelled control that speaks its action and object"

label: offline stops disabling approve, deny and submit, so a dead network posts anyway (R-rn-approvals-screen)
test: cd mobile-rn && npx jest src/screens/Approvals.test.tsx -t "KIN-MOBILE-001 R5: offline disables submit and already-read approvals stay visible"

label: a failed card's controls stay disabled, so the reason it names cannot be retried (R-rn-approvals-screen)
test: cd mobile-rn && npx jest src/screens/Approvals.test.tsx -t "KIN-MOBILE-001 R5: a failed decision restores the card as operable and names the reason"

label: the settled card drops its reader hand-off, leaving the reader on the pressed control (R-rn-approvals-focus)
test: cd mobile-rn && npx jest src/screens/Approvals.test.tsx -t "KIN-MOBILE-001 R5: approving moves the reader to the settled result row"

label: the settled question also drops its reader hand-off, leaving focus on nothing (R-rn-approvals-focus)
test: cd mobile-rn && npx jest src/screens/Approvals.test.tsx -t "KIN-MOBILE-001 R5: answering a question moves the reader to the result row the chosen option left"

label: a settled card seizes the reader on every render, stealing focus from a reloaded list (R-rn-approvals-focus)
test: cd mobile-rn && npx jest src/screens/Approvals.test.tsx -t "KIN-MOBILE-001 R5: a card that was already handled when it arrived takes no focus"

label: a failed decision leaves the reader on the button instead of the reason it must read (R-rn-approvals-focus)
test: cd mobile-rn && npx jest src/screens/Approvals.test.tsx -t "KIN-MOBILE-001 R5: a failed decision hands the reader to the reason and its retry"

label: the focus seam reports success for a node with no native handle (R-rn-approvals-focus)
test: cd mobile-rn && npx jest src/a11y/focus.test.ts -t "KIN-MOBILE-001 R5: a null ref and a node without a handle focus nothing and report false"
